Figure 1:Method overview.As tasks accumulate, a T2I harness
learns reusable skills that improve its prompts while the generator remains
fixed. D-OPCD conditions an EMA teacher on the original queryqiq_{i}and the
harness-selected promptpip_{i}, and trains a student conditioned only onqiq_{i}to match the teacher’s predictions along the student’s own denoising
trajectory. The updated generator can generate fromqiq_{i}alone, while the
harness resets its skills to continue adapting around it.
